findings.body: The test for rejecting a reset link under the lock changes only the mocked transaction result. The HTTP integration test uses an old link only after reset has finished, so it cannot catch a join that reads an active link, waits for the circle lock, and then accepts it after reset. Add a database-backed HTTP test that resets the link while the join waits and verifies the old code is refused.
findings.title: Not done: reset-during-join integration test

findings.body: The exception filter is global. Its fallback maps any HTTP 401 to UNAUTHORIZED, and this new entry makes every such response say to return to an invite. A failed session on profile, sign-out, or another protected endpoint now receives an incorrect invite-specific instruction. Apply that message only to invite errors.
findings.title: Keep the invite sign-in message off unrelated 401 responses

findings.body: The preview endpoint now deliberately returns account_required without a cookie, but ApiCookieAuth marks the cookie as required in the generated OpenAPI operation. API consumers using that contract cannot tell that signed-out preview is supported. Remove the operation-level security requirement or describe the cookie as optional.
findings.title: Document invite preview as allowing an absent session

findings.body: The guard's pending-account check is conditional on !optional, so PENDING_ROUTE has no effect on this optional-session endpoint. The added decorator is a second route flag with no behavior to preserve.
findings.title: Simpler: remove the preview's pending-route flag → use its optional-session flag

findings.body: This new Forge task-status file is outside the permitted paths and supplies no code, API contract, or test needed for the invite work. Omit it from this branch.
findings.title: Remove the task-status file outside this part's scope
